---
title: "Cellerator"
---

Cellerator is an early high-performance PyTorch extension for building
cellular dynamical models. Biology can guide both the operations a model uses
and the way those operations are organized for hardware. PyTorch remains the
foundation for ordinary tensors, standard neural layers, autograd, optimizers,
and composition.

Cellerator is designed to extend Torch where modeled structure changes the
mathematical or execution contract. It enables scientific work without
choosing the consumer's scientific assumptions. It is not a replacement for
PyTorch, Scanpy, or RAPIDS-singlecell. AnnData is required by the Python
package, but a direct AnnData preparation adapter is not yet implemented.

The library is early and not near complete. The dated
[implementation record](current_implementation.qmd) explains current
capabilities and evidence; the [architecture](architecture.qmd) describes
ownership boundaries and target organization.
